wire.requestId: positive integer unique among pending requests

negotiation.featureAdvertisedOnlyAfter: verified installed revision + host approval + authenticated account + LoopRD registry authorization + live trusted transport
negotiation.absence: fail closed; local preview still works; never infer rights from ID, package hash alone or assets.read
negotiation.unsupportedMajor: deny; no fallback to other host methods
negotiation.minor: additive only, unknown fields or methods denied in v1
negotiation.limits: status returns maxUploadBytes/maxChunkBytes; host may enforce lower limits and rate limiting

canonicalAssets.preview: unprivileged local .tavia inspection, no install or publish

assets.registry.admin.status.description: Verify current host approval and LoopRD permissions before returning operations; no cached role authority.

assets.registry.admin.stage.begin.description: Start a bounded, digest-bound upload session for a .tavia file; never import from a caller URL.

assets.registry.admin.stage.chunk.description: Upload a contiguous base64 chunk; host enforces advertised byte limits and session binding.

assets.registry.admin.stage.commit.description: Validate the complete digest and canonical Tavi Assets pack before staging; never publish.

assets.registry.admin.records.list.description: List only records visible to the authenticated administrator.

assets.registry.admin.records.get.description: Inspect an authorized staged, published, revoked or failed version; no arbitrary raw file read.

assets.registry.admin.price.propose.description: Requires native host confirmation; proposed Gold price is not a wallet charge or entitlement.

assets.registry.admin.publish.description: Requires native host confirmation bound to exact record digest, price and revision; LoopRD makes the final decision.

assets.registry.admin.revoke.description: Requires native host confirmation; LoopRD revokes the specified immutable version and records audit evidence.

scope: TaviX validates the request permission and documents host wire shapes. Tavi/Social must implement trusted host dispatch; LoopRD must implement the authoritative backend; no TaviX runtime or publication.
